title: Infleqtion Secures £9 Million ($12 Million USD) Innovate UK Award to Transition Rydberg Quantum RF Sensing to Operational Deployment - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Infleqtion (NYSE: INFQ) won a £9M (~$12M) Innovate UK award to move its Rydberg-atom quantum RF direction-finding system, developed with Leonardo, from prototype to operational deployment. The product replaces antenna arrays with optical atomic sensing for size-constrained defense platforms.

insights.claim: Infleqtion received £9 million (~$12M) from Innovate UK under the Quantum Missions Primer program to fund Phase 2 of QuDiFi, taking its Quantum Spectrum-DF product from prototype testing to operational deployment.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Public defense-oriented funding is moving quantum sensing, not computing, toward near-term fielding; INFQ is a listed name to track for sensing revenue.

insights.claim: Infleqtion is positioning the award as a milestone building on its Quantum Spectrum neutral-atom RF sensing category launch and the expansion of its UK Quantum Innovation Centre and Oxford manufacturing facility, signalling UK industrial build-out.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Capacity expansion in the UK suggests sovereign supply-chain intent behind the funding.
insights.locator: The system is designed for dual-use deployment

insights.claim: Rydberg-atom sensing detects, characterizes and locates radio signals with optical techniques instead of antenna arrays, bypassing the physical size limits of low-frequency antennas and enabling broadband passive direction finding on space-constrained mobile, aerospace and defense platforms.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: The size-weight-and-power advantage is the commercial hook for defense primes; look for adoption by platforms where antennas are the constraint.
insights.locator: Developed in collaboration with defense and aerospace group Leonardo

insights.claim: Infleqtion and Leonardo will jointly evaluate SWaP (size, weight and power) reductions across defense platforms, and applications cited include spectrum surveillance, passive radar, resilient navigation and threat geolocation, for both military and commercial infrastructure use.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Leonardo's involvement gives a defense-prime route to market; watch for evaluation results as a validation point.
